name: Default No-Feints Support
dsl: ?(deck.remaining >= 2) sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & potent @ spell(any<trap & !feint>) & potent @ spell(any<trap & !feint>) | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | any<blade & stacks>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe & !feint & stacks> | any<trap & !aoe & !feint & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<blade>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe & !feint> | any<trap & !aoe & !feint>[potent] @ boss | any<global> | any<harmful_aura & inc_damage & stronger> @ boss | pass
description: P2–P4 of Default Team Boss Duel (No Feints). Never casts or enchants a Feint or Mass Feint to avoid boss cheats. Buffs with a blade on P1 and traps, stacking ones first, then a global and a negative aura such as Attenuate on the boss. Attacks only once P1 is dead.
